this storey stands inside the comble — its floor at 19.800 m is the top of the stone face, not a level behind it — so nothing on the stone facade is composed on it: no opening, no surround, no keystone, no balcon filant, no cornice. What encloses it is the roof, and its windows are the lucarnes the termination phase stands on that roof, one per bay of this very storey's grid. Emitted empty rather than omitted, because it is still a floor of the building and still has the role the stack gave it.

trace.detail: the comble is a diagonal_45 because the decree in force says so, and for no other reason: geometry is a step on the decree date and carries no class lag, while 'pedimented_dormers' is fashion and does.
